name: integra-sys
description: Integra SYS - ERP/PDV SaaS multi-tenant com módulo fiscal real (NF-e 55 / NFC-e 65) via NFePHP/sped-nfe

scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @integra/types build && pnpm --filter @integra/shared build && pnpm --filter @integra/validation build && pnpm --filter @integra/config build && pnpm --filter @integra/database build && pnpm --filter @integra/auth build && pnpm --filter @integra/fiscal-client build && pnpm --filter @integra/ui build
scripts.build:apps: pnpm --filter @integra/api build && pnpm --filter @integra/web-saas build && pnpm --filter @integra/admin-master build
